 Planning your watchlist for the week? Take a look at OTT releases this week from October 26, 2026, to November 1, 2026, that you must watch for a happy weekend.
 1 /10 
 OTT releases this week (October 26-November 1, 2026): Akka, Drive The Pretenders , Obsession and more movies and shows to watch OTT
 Looking for something new to watch on OTT this week? The final week of October 2026 bring a good mix of crime thrillers, supernatural horror, family dramas, and more to your screens. Whether you enjoy stories packed with suspense or prefer something lighter to watch after a long day, there are several new titles to add to your weekend watchlist. Here are the top OTT releases for this week from October 26 to November 1, 2026, you can look forward to.
 2 /10 
 Minimum Wage OTT release: Comedy series about teenagers trying to keep a pizza shop running while dealing with everyday chaos.
 This comedy follows a group of teenagers trying to keep a local pizza shop running while juggling school and a demanding boss. The short episodes make it an easy watch for viewers looking for light entertainment. It is based on the American High Shorts YouTube series. Minimum Wage will stream on Netflix from October 26, 2026.
 3 /10 
 The One About Matthew Perry OTT release: Documentary revisiting the life, career and personal struggles of the Friends star Matthew Perry.
 This three-part documentary looks back at the life of Friends star Matthew Perry. It explores his rise to fame, personal struggles, and the experiences that shaped his life beyond the character of Chandler Bing. The series also features archival material and accounts from people close to him. Three-part docuseries The One About Matthew Perry premiered on October 27, 2026, and is now streaming worldwide on Netflix.
 4 /10 
 Drive - The Pretenders OTT release: A racing romance in which a fake engagement complicates the lives of two people.
 This German romantic drama follows Sarah, a young racing mechanic who pretends to be engaged to a famous racing star. She hopes the arrangement will help her get closer to her dream of becoming a driver. However, the fake relationship becomes complicated when their feelings start to change. Drive - The Pretenders will stream on Amazon Prime Video from October 28, 2026.
 5 /10 
 Dhindora Season 1 OTT release: Bhuvan Bam's comedy series follows a middle-class family whose lives take an unexpected turn.
 Bhuvan Bam's comedy series follows a middle-class family whose lives turn chaotic after a lottery ticket changes their fortunes. Bam plays several characters in the show, bringing everyday family situations and comic misunderstandings into the story. It is a pick for viewers who enjoy Indian comedy. Dhindora Season 1 will be released on October 28, 2026, on Netflix.
 --> 
 6 /10 
 Baththa OTT release: Vijay Sethupathi stars in a Tamil gangster drama that blends crime, comedy and unexpected twists.
 Starring Vijay Sethupathi, this Tamil gangster comedy-drama is set in 1980s Madras. The story follows a feared local criminal whose life takes an unexpected turn after an encounter with a young boy. It combines crime, humour, and emotional moments. Baththa is scheduled to release on Netflix on October 29, 2026.
 7 /10 
 Akka OTT release: Keerthy Suresh and Radhika Apte lead a period crime drama about rivalry and power.
 Keerthy Suresh and Radhika Apte lead this crime drama set in a fictional South Indian town during the 1980s. Two powerful women face a growing threat to their control and legacy. With Tanvi Azmi also part of the cast, the series explores power, rivalry and survival. Akka will be released on October 30, 2026, only on Netflix.
 8 /10 
 Immortal OTT release: This Tamil horror romance combines supernatural elements with a story of love and mystery.
 Starring GV Prakash Kumar and Kayadu Lohar, this Tamil romantic horror film combines relationships with supernatural elements. Directed by Mariyappan Chinna, it adds a darker option to this week's OTT releases list. Immortal will release on SonyLIV on October 30, 2026.
 9 /10 
 Rudravanam PS OTT release: A Telugu crime thriller which follows a police investigation that uncovers disturbing secrets.
 This Telugu investigative thriller follows a police officer dealing with a missing-person case in a remote village. The discovery of a headless body leads to a much darker investigation, with more disturbing incidents following. It is a good choice for fans of crime mysteries and police dramas. Rudravanam PS releases on October 30, 2026, on ZEE5.
 10 /10 
 Obsession OTT release: A young man's wish to win someone's love turns into a terrifying supernatural nightmare.
 This supernatural horror film follows a young man who wishes for the affection of someone he loves. When his wish comes true, the romance takes a frightening turn. The film explores how desire can become dangerous when love crosses the line into obsession. Obsession is set to release on October 30, 2026, and will stream on JioHotstar.
